CAT 2026 Registration Opens for Common Admission Test

Registration for the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 has commenced. The application process is now open for prospective candidates. The CAT exam structure includes sections, with each section allocated exactly 40 minutes for answering questions. Information regarding eligibility criteria and application fees is available.
